notes: Four transactions against the STRK20 Sepolia pool, each verified against the chain rather than copied from a log: register a viewing key, shield, private transfer, unshield. All four read ACCEPTED_ON_L2 / SUCCEEDED. Mainnet was not reached. The pool needs a proving service that participants are expected to self-host, which requires a v0.10 RPC and a large amd64 machine (StarkWare recommend 48 vCPU / 96 GB), and no mainnet discovery endpoint was published to us. tool/run-prover.sh stands one up on a fresh box, and the app can be pointed at a self-hosted prover with STRK20_SELF_HOSTED_PROVER.
